summary:
Airbnb 營收年增17.9%但 EPS 0.26 美元低於預期近15%，成長持續卻獲利受投資與費用拖累。
• 營收 26.8 億美元，年增 17.87%，旅遊需求穩健
• 全球訂房量與多元化（體驗、服務）拓展平台
• 品牌與供給網路效應維持市場領先
• 現金流體質與資產輕模式具韌性
ai_view:
訊號中性偏弱：營收維持雙位數成長顯示需求穩健，但 EPS 連兩季低於預期，反映管理層為擴張（體驗、服務、行銷）犧牲短期利潤。短期股價可能因獲利不如預期承壓，市場將檢視投資能否轉化為訂房量加速。中期追蹤夜晚數成長、變現率（take rate）、EBITDA 利潤率與新業務貢獻，判斷投資週期何時收割。

需留意：EPS 低於預期，行銷與新業務投入壓抑利潤率；監管（短租限制）在多城市持續趨嚴；旅遊需求對總經與消費信心敏感

summary_en:
Airbnb grew revenue 17.9% but EPS of $0.26 missed by nearly 15%, as growth continued while spending pressured earnings.
• Revenue of $2.68B grew 17.87%, reflecting resilient travel demand
• Global bookings and diversification (experiences, services) expand the platform
• Brand and supply network effects sustain market leadership
• Asset-light model supports cash flow resilience

ai_view_en:
Signal is mildly weak: double-digit revenue growth shows healthy demand, but a second straight EPS miss reflects management trading near-term profit for expansion in experiences, services and marketing. Near term the stock may be pressured by the miss, with the market scrutinizing whether spend accelerates bookings. Mid term, track nights growth, take rate, EBITDA margin and new-initiative contribution to judge when the investment cycle pays off.

Watch：EPS miss as marketing and new-initiative spend pressures margins; Tightening short-term rental regulation across cities; Travel demand sensitive to macro and consumer confidence
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 差 14.85%，惟營收年增 17.87% 仍穩健。
